AppChecklistItem.title: AppChecklistItem
AppChecklistItem.description: Exactly as printed on the activated prescription.

Box.title: Box
Box.description: Normalised 0..1 region on the page, as core.provenance stores it.

ChainCheck.title: ChainCheck
ChainCheck.description: The result of recomputing every hash in audit.event, oldest first.

ComplianceScore.title: ComplianceScore
ComplianceScore.description:
The one approved score. Computed from medication ticks only, shown to
clinicians only, and always sent with the day array it came from, so
the page can recount it.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description:
What a reviewer decided about one item.

decision_latency_ms runs from the moment the crop finished rendering to
the decision. The client cannot send a decision before that moment.

InboundSms.title: InboundSms
InboundSms.description: One message as the gateway received it. The body is never stored, only its hash.

ItemDecision.title: ItemDecision
ItemDecision.description:
A reviewer's confirmation of one line. The text fields are present only
when the reviewer corrected what was read; the original stays in the
audit log.

PaperFormSubmission.title: PaperFormSubmission
PaperFormSubmission.description: A week of a paper form, transcribed by clinic staff, stored as written.

PatientListItem.title: PatientListItem
PatientListItem.description:
One row of the patient list: who the patient is, and what the record
holds now. Counts and dates of the record only, never a judgement.

QueueItem.title: QueueItem
QueueItem.description: One open item. The value is shown as read, next to the crop it came from.

ReadLine.title: ReadLine
ReadLine.description: One line of a handwritten prescription. Every line goes to a person.

RecordValue.title: RecordValue
RecordValue.description: A renderable value, exactly as printed. Nothing derived is attached.

TraceHistory.title: TraceHistory
TraceHistory.description:
How the value reached the record. 'accepted' means every check passed
and no person was involved; the other two name the person.

Waiting.title: Waiting
Waiting.description: What still needs a person before it can be shown or ticked.
